title: Moving to New York: Ross, Charlie Skeet and Claude Hopkins
summary: Hall goes to New York with Ross's band, plays a dancing school, then Charlie Skeet and Claude Hopkins at Roseland and the Savoy.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well, different bands, I worked with quite a few different bands. I worked with, let's see, can I get them in rotation? When you first got there, I was thinking about you. When I first got there, well, I went there with Ross's band. We only stayed on the job about two weeks. Then I went into a dancing school with another, by the way it was a piano player down in Florida that was in New York. He went to New York with this Broadway gentleman. So when we got to New York and working at a big place like the Roseland, it's used to call it a Rosemont, that was in Brooklyn. And it happened, so we was playing opposite the Indiana Five. And we got ten men and there's only five guys and those guys were really playing. They made us sound bad for a while, you know. So we didn't like, Ross seems to be one of the weakest guys in the band, so we got this piano player Arthur Ford to play for us and Mick Ross the leader. But we only stayed on the job about two weeks and I went to dancing school. Coot and I got an offer right away to play in the dancing school and with this piano player Arthur Ford. So we went to the dancing school, had a little four piece band and I stayed there for about over a year. Then I left there and went with another band by the name of Charlie Skeet working in the dance with saxophone and clarinet and all that.
Then Charlie Skeet, we got rid of him and got Claude Hopkins in the band.

That's how that started, Claude Hopkins band. That's how that started and went to the Savoy Ballroom, pretty good band. So when they hired us in the Savoy Ballroom, Chick Webb Band was at the Savoy, so they went down to the Roseland Mall. So happened to the manager, happened to come in to Savoy and he said you'd rather have Claude Hopkins band than Chick Webb Band. That's how we got into the Roseland Mall. We Claude Hopkins band. Do you know Geechee Fields? Traumhole player? Traumhole player. Yeah, I don't know too much about him, I remember him. Geechee Fields, yeah. I just wondered if you knew what had happened to him.
